Cancer is one of the most challenging health issues faced by humanity, but advancements in medical science have given us powerful tools to combat it. Among these tools, chemotherapy stands out as a cornerstone of cancer treatment, offering hope and improving outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

### Why Chemotherapy is Effective

Chemotherapy works by using strong chemical drugs to target and destroy cancer cells that grow and divide rapidly. While cancer cells are the primary targets, chemotherapy can also affect healthy cells that divide quickly, such as those in the hair follicles, mouth, and digestive system.
